definitions.explanation: A collective term for all types of noodles and noodle-based dishes, including udon, soba, ramen, and pasta.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{麺類|めんるい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧だ。
examples.english: This restaurant has a wide variety of noodle dishes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{麺類|めんるい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧、そば、⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese noodle dishes include various types such as udon, soba, and ramen.

notes:
{麺類|めんるい} is a categorical term that covers all types of noodles. The suffix ⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧ means "kind" or "category," so {麺類|めんるい} literally means "the noodle category."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {麺類|めんるい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧ (to like noodles)
- {麺類|めんるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{茹|ゆ}でる→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧ (to boil noodles)
- {麺類|めんるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧ (the noodle menu)

USAGE:
This word appears frequently on menus and in food-related contexts. It is a useful category word when talking about food preferences. The ⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧ suffix is productive in Japanese and appears in other food categories like ⟦{魚類|ぎょるい}→魚類：04925_gyorui⟧ (fish), {肉類|にくるい} (meats), and ⟦{穀類|こくるい}→穀類：19477_kokurui⟧ (grains).
